about: Anonymous strips derived 2026-11-19 from ChromIQ measurement files on the developer's disk (the clean corpus of ~/Desktop/ChromIQ-work/2026-11-19_shift450): per strip only the chart's paper XYZ (its brightest expected colour) and, per patch in row order, the read XYZ and the expected XYZ (the chart's .ti2 where it was beside the file, else targen 3.5.0's default model). No file names, strip names, spectra, device values or headers. 'honest': strips that pass the helper's colour check today and are not known misreads (the 150 hardest of 4,665 by shift score, plus 250 chosen at random); 'misread': real strips read one patch out.
